persona.name: Daniel Okafor
persona.summary: Backend engineer with about two years of Python experience on AWS
persona.background: Joined a logistics SaaS company after graduating in 2024 and owns several FastAPI services. Did a Java internship at a bank before that. Applying for backend and platform roles, and occasionally DevOps or data roles.
goals: Emphasise different parts of the same job for backend, DevOps, and data roles
Avoid being filtered out for missing Kubernetes or Kafka when he has related experience
frustrations: Rewriting the same six bullets for each application
Tools that add technologies he has never used
evaluator_notes: Has SQS and Celery, not Kafka or Airflow
No Kubernetes evidence; ECS is related but different
About 2 years 3 months of professional experience as of October 2026

bullets.bullet_text: Build and maintain 12 FastAPI services for shipment tracking, handling about 3M API requests per day
Cut p95 latency of the tracking API from 820ms to 240ms by adding Redis caching and rewriting two PostgreSQL queries
Moved nightly label generation to Celery workers on AWS ECS with SQS, removing a 40-minute batch window
Wrote Terraform modules for SQS queues and IAM roles used by three teams
Set up GitHub Actions pipelines that run pytest and deploy Docker images to ECS
Take part in the weekly on-call rotation and wrote 5 incident reviews using Sentry and CloudWatch data
Added two REST endpoints to a Java Spring Boot account-statements service, with JUnit tests
Fixed 15 backlog bugs in a legacy Oracle-backed reporting service

projects.description: Contribution to an open-source Python HTTP retry library

bullets.bullet_text: Contributed exponential backoff with jitter to an open-source Python HTTP retry library; merged after maintainer review
Wrote a rate-limiting service in Go backed by Redis, load-tested locally to 20k requests per second
